title: Imported-services three-way match with CMA caveat
scope: BP5: match A money out (bank statements via TAX-079 payment-channel records), B books (TAX-113 ledger) and C declared VAT/WHT (e-Tax contract) per counterparty, period and service type, within FX and timing tolerances

acceptance.text: Per counterparty and period the result shows A, B, C, differences and tolerance used, with evidence IDs for each source; legitimate explanations (treaty relief, exempt service, goods not services, timing) are tested and recorded before any flag

Flags carry a plain-language reason and route: small gaps to a standard-lane targeted request, material gaps to Special Sectors; the CMA caveat is stated in the output when Central Bank data is absent and company bank statements are treated as primary

Synthetic fixture reproduces the framework exception journey (M2.4m management fees to a South African parent, no VAT/WHT declared) plus a matched counterparty and a treaty-relief case; tests cover all three
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

verification: Synthetic fixture reproduces the framework exception journey (M2.4m management fees to a South African parent, no VAT/WHT declared) plus a matched counterparty and a treaty-relief case; tests cover all three

evidence.text: ai/tools/foreign_payments.py: per counterparty over the review window (or per year) shows money out, booked services/interest, WHT declared/expected, imported-services VAT expected, tolerance and evidence IDs; treaty relief with certificate, exempt service and timing tested first. Bank file parsed by the TAX-079 ForeignPaymentAdapter in the TAX-118 pipeline.

Flags carry plain-language reasons and route_recommendation (standard_lane_request / special_sectors_review by materiality); CMA caveat in every result and a cma_payment_not_in_central_bank_data note per CMA counterparty.

data/synthetic/tax115_foreign_payments.json reproduces the M2.4m ZA-parent journey plus a treaty-relief advisor and a correctly declared supplier; ForeignMatchTests assert flags, 'M2.4m' and 'no treaty relief found', explanations, CMA note, account-not-name joins and missing-certificate question.
